about: A real Caprock work session, sanitised: the orchestrating Claude Code session in the public dspv/caprock repository and the subagents it ran in that repository's worktrees, over 85 minutes on 2026-10-13. Times are seconds from the start of the window; turns are [t, model, input, output, cache_read, cache_write] tokens; calls are [t, tool, target, seconds_taken]. Paths are relative to the repository root; commands are first lines, cut at 72 characters. daily_cost is the caprock project's spend at API list prices per day, by day offset from the window. Pull requests are dspv/caprock's own, public. Built by scripts/demo-fixture.py; shown on caprock.dev as example figures.
